stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Dr. Christina Raynor is Bucky Barnes' government-mandated therapist after his pardon. She pushes him to make amends and open up to people, and she does not buy his claim that he just wants peace.
stages.whoA: His court-ordered therapist, who pushes him to make amends and open up.
stages.whoB: Her patient, ordered into therapy after his pardon. She doubts he just wants peace.

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Bucky Barnes and Dum Dum Dugan are among the prisoners Steve Rogers frees from HYDRA, and both join his Howling Commandos. They fight together across Europe until Bucky's fall.
stages.whoA: A fellow Howling Commando, freed with him from HYDRA's prison camp.
stages.whoB: A fellow Howling Commando, freed with him from HYDRA, until Bucky falls.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Everett Ross takes custody of Bucky Barnes after his capture in Bucharest and has him held in Berlin. When Zemo triggers Bucky's programming, he breaks loose from Ross' facility.
stages.whoA: The official who holds him in Berlin after his capture in Bucharest.
stages.whoB: The Winter Soldier, held in his custody in Berlin until Zemo sets him loose.

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Bucky Barnes runs into Georges Batroc when the mercenary turns up fighting for the Flag Smashers. Bucky battles him alongside Sam Wilson, and Batroc covers the Flag Smashers' escape with a cloud of smoke.
stages.whoA: A mercenary fighting for the Flag Smashers. He covers their escape with smoke.
stages.whoB: The former Winter Soldier, who fights him alongside Sam Wilson.

stages.title: Thunderbolts*
stages.text: Ghost is one of Valentina's disposable agents who joins Bucky Barnes' makeshift team after the vault. She fights alongside him to save New York from the Void.
stages.whoA: One of Valentina's disposable agents, on his makeshift team against the Void.
stages.whoB: The congressman whose makeshift team she joins to save New York from the Void.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Helmut Zemo uses HYDRA's trigger words to unleash the Winter Soldier and frame Bucky Barnes for the Vienna bombing.
stages.whoA: The man who unleashes the Winter Soldier and frames him for Vienna.
stages.whoB: The Winter Soldier, whom he unleashes with HYDRA's trigger words and frames for Vienna.

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Bucky Barnes breaks Zemo out of prison to help hunt the Flag Smashers, and the two team up uneasily.
stages.whoA: Framed him for Vienna. Now sprung from prison to help hunt the Flag Smashers.
stages.whoB: The man he framed. Now breaks him out of prison to hunt the Flag Smashers.

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Bucky Barnes and Howard Stark are on the same side in the war against HYDRA.
stages.whoA: An ally in the war against HYDRA.
stages.whoB: A soldier on his side in the war against HYDRA.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: In 1991 the brainwashed Winter Soldier kills Howard Stark and steals the super soldier serum he was carrying.
stages.whoA: A man he kills as the Winter Soldier in 1991, stealing the serum he carried.
stages.whoB: His killer. The brainwashed Winter Soldier murders him in 1991 for the serum.

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: As the Winter Soldier, Bucky Barnes fought Isaiah in Korea in 1951. Decades later Bucky brings Sam Wilson to meet him, and Isaiah is still bitter about how he was treated.
stages.whoA: A super soldier he fought in Korea in 1951, now bitter about his treatment.
stages.whoB: The Winter Soldier he fought in Korea, who later brings Sam to meet him.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: Jack Rollins works alongside the Winter Soldier on HYDRA's hunt for Steve Rogers in Washington. He guards Bucky while his damaged arm is repaired and warns Pierce that the asset has become unpredictable.
stages.whoA: A HYDRA agent on the hunt for Steve, who guards him during his arm repair.
stages.whoB: HYDRA's Winter Soldier, whom he works with and guards during his arm repair.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: James Rhodes sides with Tony Stark over the Sokovia Accords. He corners Bucky Barnes and Steve Rogers at the end of the Bucharest chase and fights Bucky at the Leipzig airport.
stages.whoA: War Machine, on Tony's side. He fights him at the Leipzig airport.
stages.whoB: The fugitive on Steve's side, whom he corners in Bucharest and fights at Leipzig.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: James Rhodes and Bucky Barnes fight side by side in Wakanda against Thanos' army.
stages.whoA: War Machine. Fought him over the Accords, now fights beside him in Wakanda.
stages.whoB: Fought him over the Accords. Now fights beside him in Wakanda.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: As the Winter Soldier, Bucky Barnes pulls Jasper Sitwell out of a moving car and kills him.
stages.whoA: A HYDRA agent he pulls from a moving car and kills.
stages.whoB: The Winter Soldier, who pulls him from a moving car and kills him.

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Bucky Barnes and Jim Morita are freed from the same HYDRA prison camp and join Steve Rogers' Howling Commandos. They fight together across Europe until Bucky's fall.
stages.whoA: A fellow Howling Commando, freed from the same HYDRA camp.
stages.whoB: A fellow Howling Commando, freed from the same HYDRA camp. Lost when he falls.

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Joaquin Torres works alongside Bucky Barnes as they help Sam hunt the Flag Smashers, flying with them into Germany.
stages.whoA: An Air Force lieutenant helping him and Sam hunt the Flag Smashers.
stages.whoB: Sam's teammate, alongside him in the Flag Smasher hunt and the flight to Germany.

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: John Walker takes up the Captain America shield, and Bucky Barnes refuses to accept him in the role. When Walker kills a man in public, Bucky and Sam fight him and take the shield back.
stages.whoA: The new Captain America, whom he refuses to accept. He takes back the shield.
stages.whoB: Steve's old friend, who rejects him as Captain America and takes the shield back.

stages.title: Thunderbolts*
stages.text: Bucky Barnes works with John Walker and the rest of Valentina's outcasts to stop Valentina de Fontaine.
stages.whoA: The disgraced Captain America he fought. Now a teammate against Valentina.
stages.whoB: Took his shield away. Now on the same team against Valentina.

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Bucky Barnes and Sam Wilson hunt Karli Morgenthau and her Flag Smashers across Europe. In their first clash she kicks Bucky off a moving truck with super soldier strength, and he later helps stop her final attack on the GRC in New York.
stages.whoA: Leader of the Flag Smashers, a super soldier who kicks him off a truck.
stages.whoB: The Winter Soldier, hunting her across Europe with Sam. He helps stop her final attack.

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Lemar Hoskins teams up uneasily with Bucky Barnes and Sam Wilson while they all chase the Flag Smashers.
stages.whoA: Walker's partner, an uneasy teammate in the chase for the Flag Smashers.
stages.whoB: An uneasy teammate in the chase for the Flag Smashers.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: On HYDRA's orders, the Winter Soldier kills Maria Stark right after killing her husband Howard on a December night in 1991.
stages.whoA: Howard's wife, whom he kills as the Winter Soldier in 1991.
stages.whoB: Her killer. The brainwashed Winter Soldier murders her right after her husband.

stages.title: Thunderbolts*
stages.text: Mel is Valentina de Fontaine's assistant, and Bucky Barnes tries to turn her against her boss. She refuses to testify, but she quietly tips him off to track Valentina's phone.
stages.whoA: Valentina's assistant. She won't testify, but tips him off to track Valentina.
stages.whoB: A congressman who tries to turn her against her boss, Valentina.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: The Winter Soldier shot Natasha Romanoff years ago while killing her target, and he comes after her again when HYDRA rises in Washington.
stages.whoA: An old target he once shot. HYDRA sends him after her again in Washington.
stages.whoB: The Winter Soldier, who shot her years ago and comes after her again.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Natasha Romanoff and Bucky Barnes end up on the same side in Wakanda, fighting off Thanos' army.
stages.whoA: Once his target. Now on the same side against Thanos' army in Wakanda.
stages.whoB: The Winter Soldier who once shot her. Now an ally in Wakanda.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: Under HYDRA's orders the Winter Soldier ambushes Nick Fury in Washington and shoots him through a wall, leaving him for dead.
stages.whoA: A target he shoots through a wall in Washington on HYDRA's orders.
stages.whoB: The Winter Soldier, who ambushes him in Washington and leaves him for dead.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Okoye and Bucky Barnes fight side by side in Wakanda when Thanos' army attacks.
stages.whoA: A Wakandan general fighting beside him when Thanos' army attacks.
stages.whoB: An ally fighting beside her in Wakanda when Thanos' army attacks.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Peter Parker and Bucky Barnes are on opposite sides of the Sokovia Accords split. Peter takes him on for Tony Stark at the Leipzig airport, catching his metal fist and marveling at the arm.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, on Tony's side. He catches Bucky's metal fist at Leipzig.
stages.whoB: A foe at Leipzig, whose metal fist he catches and marvels at.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Peter Parker and Bucky Barnes fight on the same side in the Battle of Earth.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man. Fought him at Leipzig, now on the same side against Thanos.
stages.whoB: The metal-armed foe from Leipzig, now on his side in the Battle of Earth.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: Sam Wilson fights the Winter Soldier in Washington while helping Steve Rogers bring down HYDRA.
stages.whoA: Steve's friend, who fights the Winter Soldier while helping bring down HYDRA.
stages.whoB: The Winter Soldier. He fights him in Washington while helping Steve.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Sam Wilson sides with Steve Rogers to protect Bucky Barnes after the Vienna bombing. The two bicker constantly while they fight together against Tony Stark's side.
stages.whoA: Sides with Steve to protect him after Vienna. They bicker nonstop.
stages.whoB: Steve's old friend, whom he helps protect after Vienna. They bicker nonstop.

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Sam Wilson and Bucky Barnes start out bickering, but they become a real team and true friends while hunting the Flag Smashers.
stages.whoA: His partner against the Flag Smashers, and in the end a true friend.
stages.whoB: His partner against the Flag Smashers. The bickering turns into real friendship.

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Sarah Wilson welcomes Bucky Barnes when he comes to Louisiana, and he helps her and Sam fix up the family boat.
stages.whoA: Sam's sister, who welcomes him in Louisiana. He helps fix the family boat.
stages.whoB: Her brother's friend, who comes to Louisiana and helps fix the family boat.

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Bucky Barnes poses as the Winter Soldier to meet Selby in Madripoor and ask about the serum.
stages.whoA: A Madripoor criminal he meets posing as the Winter Soldier, asking about the serum.
stages.whoB: The Winter Soldier, back in character to question her about the serum.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Sharon Carter helps Bucky Barnes and Steve Rogers by smuggling them their gear in Germany.
stages.whoA: A CIA agent who smuggles him and Steve their gear in Germany.
stages.whoB: Steve's fugitive friend, whom she helps by smuggling their gear in Germany.

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Sharon Carter shelters Bucky, Sam and Zemo in Madripoor and helps them track the serum. All the while she is secretly running the city as the Power Broker.
stages.whoA: Their host in Madripoor, helping track the serum. Secretly the Power Broker.
stages.whoB: A guest she shelters in Madripoor while secretly ruling it as the Power Broker.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: Shuri helps clear the Winter Soldier programming from Bucky Barnes' mind in Wakanda, and the two become friends.
stages.whoA: His friend, who clears the Winter Soldier programming from his mind.
stages.whoB: Her friend, whose mind she frees of the Winter Soldier programming.

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Bucky Barnes and Steve Rogers are best friends from their childhood in Brooklyn. Bucky fights at Steve's side with the Howling Commandos until he falls from Zola's train.
stages.whoA: His best friend since Brooklyn. He fights at Steve's side until his fall.
stages.whoB: His best friend since Brooklyn, a Howling Commando until he falls from Zola's train.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: HYDRA has turned Bucky into the Winter Soldier, and he no longer knows Steve when they clash in Washington. Steve refuses to fight him on the helicarrier, and Bucky pulls him out of the river.
stages.whoA: His best friend, whom he no longer remembers. He pulls Steve from the river.
stages.whoB: His best friend, now HYDRA's Winter Soldier, who no longer knows him.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Steve Rogers stands by Bucky Barnes after he is framed for the Vienna bombing, protecting him even against Tony Stark.
stages.whoA: His best friend, who stands by him after he is framed for Vienna.
stages.whoB: His best friend, framed for Vienna. He protects him, even against Tony.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: T'Challa hunts Bucky Barnes, believing he killed his father, until he learns Zemo framed him. He then gives Bucky refuge in Wakanda.
stages.whoA: Wakanda's new king, who hunts him for his father's death, then shelters him.
stages.whoB: The man he blames for his father's death, until he learns Zemo framed him.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Freed of HYDRA's programming in Wakanda, Bucky Barnes fights for T'Challa when Thanos' army attacks.
stages.whoA: The king who sheltered him. He fights for T'Challa against Thanos.
stages.whoB: The man he sheltered, now free and fighting for Wakanda against Thanos.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Thaddeus Ross wants Bucky Barnes captured after the bombing in Vienna.
stages.whoA: The Secretary of State who wants him captured after Vienna.
stages.whoB: The fugitive he wants captured after the Vienna bombing.

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Bucky Barnes is freed from a HYDRA prison camp along with the men who become the Howling Commandos, and he fights at their side under Steve Rogers. He is with them until he falls from Zola's train.
stages.whoA: His unit under Steve, freed from the same HYDRA camp. With them until his fall.
stages.whoB: Their comrade under Steve, freed from the same HYDRA camp, until he falls.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Tony Stark learns that the brainwashed Winter Soldier murdered his parents, and he tries to kill Bucky Barnes in Siberia, blasting off his metal arm.
stages.whoA: Son of the Starks he killed. In Siberia he blasts off Bucky's arm.
stages.whoB: His parents' killer, the brainwashed Winter Soldier. He tries to kill him in Siberia.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Tony Stark and Bucky Barnes fight on the same side in the Battle of Earth.
stages.whoA: Son of the Starks he killed. Now an ally in the Battle of Earth.
stages.whoB: His parents' killer. Now an ally in the Battle of Earth.

stages.title: Thunderbolts*
stages.text: Bucky Barnes, now a congressman, tries to bring down Valentina Allegra de Fontaine over her secret Sentry project. He teams up with her disposable agents to stop her, but she spins it by branding them the New Avengers.
stages.whoA: The CIA director he tries to bring down over her secret Sentry project.
stages.whoB: A congressman out to bring her down. She brands his team the New Avengers.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Vasily Karpov is the HYDRA officer who keeps the Winter Soldier's trigger words, and in 1991 he sends Bucky Barnes to kill Howard and Maria Stark. Years later Zemo tracks Karpov down to take those words.
stages.whoA: His HYDRA handler, who keeps his trigger words and sends him after the Starks.
stages.whoB: His Winter Soldier, sent in 1991 to kill Howard and Maria Stark.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Vision tries to stop Bucky Barnes and Steve Rogers from escaping at the Leipzig airport, using the Mind Stone to block their path.
stages.whoA: An Avenger on Tony's side, who blocks his escape at Leipzig.
stages.whoB: One of Steve's side, whose escape he blocks at the Leipzig airport.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Bucky Barnes helps defend Wakanda while Shuri works to remove the Mind Stone from Vision.
stages.whoA: Blocked him at Leipzig. Now he defends Wakanda while Shuri works on Vision.
stages.whoB: Once a foe at Leipzig. Now helps defend Wakanda while Shuri works on him.

stages.title: Thunderbolts*
stages.text: Bucky Barnes, now a congressman, rescues Yelena Belova and her fellow outcasts after they escape Valentina's vault, and he pushes them to take Valentina down. Yelena ends up leading the team, which Valentina rebrands as the New Avengers.
stages.whoA: One of Valentina's outcasts, whom he rescues and pushes to take her down.
stages.whoB: The congressman who rescues her team and pushes them to take Valentina down.

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Yori Nakajima is Bucky Barnes' neighbor and lunch companion in Brooklyn. He does not know that Bucky killed his son as the Winter Soldier, until Bucky finally confesses.
stages.whoA: His Brooklyn neighbor and lunch friend, whose son he killed as the Winter Soldier.
stages.whoB: His neighbor and lunch companion, who finally confesses to killing his son.

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: John McIver, called Bushmaster, comes to Harlem for revenge on Mariah Dillard and beats Luke in a fight. Later the two make a temporary alliance against her.
stages.whoA: A hero he beats in a fight, then joins against Mariah for a time.
stages.whoB: A man out to avenge himself on Mariah, who beats him, then allies with him.

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Bushmaster wants revenge on the Stokes family and tries to kill Mariah Dillard.
stages.whoA: His target. He wants revenge on the Stokes family and tries to kill her.
stages.whoB: A man out for revenge on the Stokes family, who tries to kill her.

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Misty investigates Bushmaster during his war on Mariah Dillard and questions him about the attempt on Mariah's life. He greets her as Babylon's finest and boasts that he needs no gun or prosthetic arm to have power.
stages.whoA: A detective who questions him about the attempt on Mariah's life.
stages.whoB: Bushmaster, the man she investigates during his war on Mariah.

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Inspector Priscilla Ridley leads the police against Bushmaster.
stages.whoA: The police inspector who leads the force against him.
stages.whoB: Bushmaster, the man she leads the police against.

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: When Shades goes to the Yardies for the money Mariah Dillard needs, he finds Bushmaster in charge, a man set on destroying her. Shades spends the war that follows trying to keep Mariah alive against him.
stages.whoA: Mariah's right hand, who fights to keep her alive against him.
stages.whoB: The Yardie leader set on destroying Mariah. He fights to keep her alive.

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Tilda Johnson treats Bushmaster with her herbs. They start as enemies and become allies.
stages.whoA: A herbalist who treats him. They start as enemies and become allies.
stages.whoB: A patient she treats with her herbs. An enemy who becomes an ally.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Jason Wilkes is a scientist working for Calvin Chadwick's company, Isodyne Energy.
stages.whoA: A scientist at his company, Isodyne Energy.
stages.whoB: His boss, the head of Isodyne Energy.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Peggy Carter investigates Calvin Chadwick after learning he was rumored to be the lover of a murdered woman. Chadwick charms her at the races, then agrees to Whitney Frost's plan to have her killed.
stages.whoA: An agent investigating him. He charms her, then agrees to have her killed.
stages.whoB: A suspect she investigates. He charms her, then agrees to have her killed.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Rufus Hunt is the Arena Club's head of security and works for Calvin Chadwick and the Council. Whitney Frost pushes Chadwick into letting Hunt kill Peggy Carter, and when Hunt later tries to blackmail Chadwick, Whitney absorbs him with Zero Matter.
stages.whoA: His Arena Club security chief, who later tries to blackmail him.
stages.whoB: His boss at the Arena Club, whom he later tries to blackmail.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Calvin Chadwick and Vernon Masters are friends and fellow members of the Council of Nine.
stages.whoA: His friend and fellow member of the Council of Nine.
stages.whoB: His friend and fellow member of the Council of Nine.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Whitney Frost is Calvin Chadwick's wife and the real brains behind his career. She kills him with Zero Matter.
stages.whoA: His wife and the real brains behind his career. She kills him.
stages.whoB: Her husband, whose career she runs from behind. She kills him with Zero Matter.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Calvin Zabo is Daisy Johnson's father. He spends years trying to get his daughter back, and in the end he kills her mother Jiaying to save her.
stages.whoA: His daughter, whom he spends years trying to get back.
stages.whoB: Her father. He kills her mother Jiaying to save her.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Calvin Zabo teams up with Daniel Whitehall to get close to the man who hurt his wife, planning to kill him.
stages.whoA: The man who hurt his wife, whom he joins while planning to kill him.
stages.whoB: A man who teams up with him, secretly planning to kill him.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Gordon has little patience for Calvin Zabo, telling him he is no Inhuman, just a science experiment. He warps Cal away before he can kill Coulson, and later captures him to end his war on S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.whoA: An Inhuman who calls him a science experiment and finally captures him.
stages.whoB: Daisy's father, whom he scorns and finally captures to end his war on S.H.I.E.L.D.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Calvin Zabo threatens Jemma and the team, and she fends him off with an I.C.E.R. when he transforms. When his heart stops, she revives him with adrenaline, which accidentally completes the formula in his blood.
stages.whoA: A S.H.I.E.L.D. scientist who fends him off, then accidentally completes his formula.
stages.whoB: Skye's father. She fends him off, then revives him, completing his formula by accident.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Calvin Zabo is Jiaying's husband. When she turns murderous, he kills her.
stages.whoA: His wife. When she turns murderous, he kills her.
stages.whoB: Her husband, who kills her when she turns murderous.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Calvin Zabo forces his way into helping Fitz and Coulson save Trip's life, threatening to kill Trip if Coulson shoots him. Later, powered up by his own formula, he smashes out of the medical pod and comes after Fitz and the others.
stages.whoA: An agent he forces to let him help save Trip, then attacks.
stages.whoB: Skye's father, who forces his way into saving Trip and later attacks them.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Melinda May faces off with Calvin Zabo as he hunts for his daughter Skye and tries to win her over. When Jiaying hands him over as a peace offering, Skye delivers her father into May's custody.
stages.whoA: An agent who faces him down and takes him into custody.
stages.whoB: Skye's father, hunting his daughter. Skye delivers him into her custody.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Calvin Zabo blames Phil Coulson for keeping his daughter Daisy from him and tries to kill him. In the end he helps Coulson stop Jiaying, and Coulson gives him a fresh start with his memories wiped.
stages.whoA: The man he blames for keeping his daughter. Later gives him a fresh start.
stages.whoB: Daisy's father. He tries to kill him, then helps stop Jiaying.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Raina knew Calvin Zabo since she was a girl. She brings him news of his daughter and works with him for a time.
stages.whoA: An old acquaintance since her girlhood, who brings him news of his daughter.
stages.whoB: A man she has known since girlhood. She works with him for a time.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Camilla Reyes, an old friend of Coulson's, first fights beside May's team in Peru, then has her squad knock May out with gas so they can seize the Bus and the 0-8-4. May and the team break free and take the plane back.
stages.whoA: A S.H.I.E.L.D. agent she fights beside, then gasses to seize the Bus.
stages.whoB: Coulson's old friend, who fights beside her, then gasses her to seize the Bus.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Camilla Reyes is a Peruvian officer and Phil Coulson's former love interest. She betrays him to steal an alien artifact.
stages.whoA: Her former love, whom she betrays to steal an alien artifact.
stages.whoB: His former love interest, a Peruvian officer who betrays him.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Candace Miller waits tables at Cottonmouth's club, Harlem's Paradise, and is too scared to bring him drinks alone. After his death, Mariah Dillard uses her to frame Luke Cage for the murder.
stages.whoA: Her boss at Harlem's Paradise, too frightening to serve drinks alone.
stages.whoB: A waitress at his club, too scared to bring him drinks alone.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Candace Miller is one of the hostages Diamondback's men take at Harlem's Paradise, and Diamondback threatens her life. He knows she is the witness Mariah Dillard bribed and wants her dealt with.
stages.whoA: The man who takes her hostage and threatens her life.
stages.whoB: The witness Mariah bribed, a hostage he wants dealt with.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Candace Miller works at Harlem's Paradise alongside Luke. She is murdered for agreeing to testify against Diamondback and the Stokes family.
stages.whoA: Her coworker at Harlem's Paradise.
stages.whoB: A coworker at Harlem's Paradise, murdered for agreeing to testify.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: After Cottonmouth's murder, Mariah Dillard orders Candace to tell the police that Luke Cage did it and pays her off for the lie. When Candace's guilt drives her to Misty Knight, Mariah has her killed.
stages.whoA: The woman who pays her to frame Luke, then has her killed.
stages.whoB: A waitress she pays to frame Luke, then has killed.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Misty persuades Candace Miller to testify, and after that Candace is murdered.
stages.whoA: The detective who persuades her to testify.
stages.whoB: A witness she persuades to testify, who is murdered soon after.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Shades drives Mariah to pay Candace off for her false statement. When Candace decides to tell Misty the truth, Shades lures her out with Misty's stolen phone and kills her.
stages.whoA: Mariah's fixer, who lures her out with Misty's phone and kills her.
stages.whoB: A witness he pays off, then kills when she turns to Misty.

stages.whoB: The Absorbing Man, whom she helps May take down.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Graviton absorbs Creel, and Creel dies when Daisy blasts Graviton out into space.

stages.whoB: The Absorbing Man, who dies inside Graviton when she blasts it into space.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Daniel Whitehall takes Carl Creel on as his brainwashed assassin and has him steal the Obelisk back from the military. Creel obeys every order, though he cares nothing for HYDRA's goals.
stages.whoA: The HYDRA leader who brainwashes him into an assassin.
stages.whoB: His brainwashed assassin, who steals the Obelisk back for him.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Under Daniel Whitehall's orders, Carl Creel ambushes Glenn Talbot to learn where the Obelisk is kept.
stages.whoA: An Army general he ambushes to find the Obelisk.
stages.whoB: HYDRA's assassin, who ambushes him to learn where the Obelisk is.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Free of HYDRA's control and sorry for what he did, Creel wins Glenn Talbot's trust and becomes his personal bodyguard. He helps rescue Talbot from Malick's men.

stages.whoB: His remorseful former attacker, now his trusted personal bodyguard.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Both end up in General Hale's program, and once Talbot is twisted by the Gravitonium, he turns on Creel and absorbs him.
stages.whoA: The general he once guarded, who turns on him and absorbs him.
stages.whoB: His former bodyguard, whom he absorbs once the Gravitonium twists him.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: General R. Hale recruits Carl Creel after the Superior's attempt on his life, convincing him that S.H.I.E.L.D. is the enemy and making him a pawn of HYDRA once more. She tells him she is putting together a team, not hiring a gun.
stages.whoA: The general who recruits him, making him a HYDRA pawn again.
stages.whoB: A recruit she convinces that S.H.I.E.L.D. is the enemy, a HYDRA pawn once more.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Carl Creel attacks Isabelle Hartley's team during a deal, and in the fight she grabs the Obelisk with her bare hand. She survives losing the hand, but Creel then causes the car crash that kills her.
stages.whoA: A S.H.I.E.L.D. agent whose team he attacks. He causes the crash that kills her.
stages.whoB: The Absorbing Man, who attacks her team and causes the crash that kills her.

stages.whoB: The boxer he faces in his final fight.

stages.text: Jemma Simmons studies Carl Creel after S.H.I.E.L.D. captures him, questioning him in a containment module and testing his blood to learn how he could touch the Diviner and survive.
stages.whoA: A S.H.I.E.L.D. scientist who questions him and tests his blood.
stages.whoB: A captured subject she tests to learn how he survived the Diviner.

stages.text: S.H.I.E.L.D. sends John Garrett to terminate Carl Creel, but Garrett, secretly HYDRA, fakes his death and recruits him as an assassin instead.
stages.whoA: The HYDRA man who fakes his death and recruits him as an assassin.
stages.whoB: A target he was sent to kill, recruited instead as HYDRA's assassin.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Carl Creel attacks Isabelle Hartley's team and nearly kills Lance Hunter, then causes the crash that kills Hartley. Hunter becomes obsessed with revenge and even knocks out his own teammates to go after Creel.
stages.whoA: Hartley's teammate, who hunts him for revenge after her death.
stages.whoB: Hartley's killer, who nearly kills him too. He is obsessed with revenge.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Fitz turns his old Overkill Device designs into a weapon that overloads Carl Creel's absorption powers so Coulson can stop him.
stages.whoA: The engineer whose weapon overloads his absorption powers.
stages.whoB: The Absorbing Man, whose powers his Overkill weapon overloads.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Lincoln Campbell ambushes Carl Creel in a parking lot, thinking he is stalking Coulson and Glenn Talbot, and his electric powers prove too much for Creel. He nearly kills Creel before Coulson orders him to stop.
stages.whoA: An Inhuman whose electric powers overwhelm him in a parking lot ambush.
stages.whoB: A man he ambushes, thinking he is stalking Coulson. He nearly kills him.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: May clashes with Carl Creel, the Absorbing Man, after he kills Isabelle Hartley's team over the Obelisk. She saves Glenn Talbot from him by kicking Creel away, and Skye stuns him so Talbot's soldiers can take him.
stages.whoA: An agent who kicks him away to save Talbot.
stages.whoB: The Absorbing Man, who kills Hartley's team. She fights him off Talbot.

stages.text: Phil Coulson stops the Absorbing Man, Carl Creel, by stabbing him with a device that disrupts his powers.
stages.whoA: The S.H.I.E.L.D. director who stops him with a power-disrupting device.
stages.whoB: The Absorbing Man, whom he stops with a device that disrupts his powers.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Free of HYDRA's control, Creel joins Coulson's mission as Glenn Talbot's bodyguard and saves Coulson and Talbot from Malick's men.
stages.whoA: Once his captor. Now an ally on his mission, guarding Talbot.
stages.whoB: Once his foe. Now Talbot's bodyguard, who saves him from Malick's men.

stages.text: Working for General Hale, Creel listens when Coulson warns him she is using him, and he helps Coulson break Talbot out.

stages.whoB: Hale's man, who heeds his warning and helps break Talbot out.

stages.whoB: HYDRA's man chasing the Obelisk, who turns down her carbyne ring.

stages.whoA: Hale's daughter, a fellow recruit who tries to kill him.
stages.whoB: A fellow recruit in her mother's program, whom she tries to kill.

stages.text: Sunil Bakshi is HYDRA's handler for Carl Creel, passing on Whitehall's orders and rewards. He sends Creel to kill Roger Browning and to go after the Obelisk.
stages.whoA: His HYDRA handler, who passes on Whitehall's orders.
stages.whoB: The assassin he handles for HYDRA, sent after Browning and the Obelisk.

stages.whoB: His partner and best friend on the force, forced by Fisk to kill him.

stages.whoA: One of his lawyers when he testifies against Fisk.
stages.whoB: A corrupt detective he and Matt represent when he testifies against Fisk.

stages.text: James Wesley handles Detective Carl Hoffman as one of Fisk's corrupt cops.
stages.whoA: Fisk's right hand and his handler.
stages.whoB: One of Fisk's corrupt cops, whom he handles.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Carl Hoffman goes on the run after killing his partner. Matt Murdock catches him, then serves as his lawyer when he testifies against Fisk.
stages.whoA: The man who catches him on the run, then serves as his lawyer.
stages.whoB: A corrupt cop he catches on the run, then represents when he testifies.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Detective Carl Hoffman is a corrupt cop who works for Fisk. He later testifies against Fisk and helps bring down his empire.
stages.whoA: His boss, whom he serves as a corrupt cop and later testifies against.
stages.whoB: A corrupt cop on his payroll, who testifies against him.

stages.title: The Marvels
stages.text: Dar-Benn blames Carol for the civil war that ruins Hala after she destroys the Supreme Intelligence. Armed with a Quantum Band, she drains other worlds to restore Hala until Carol, Monica and Kamala stop her.
stages.whoA: A Kree leader who blames her for Hala's ruin and drains other worlds.
stages.whoB: Captain Marvel, whom she blames for Hala's civil war.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Carol rescues G'iah, Talos's young daughter, along with the other Skrull refugees.
stages.whoA: Talos's young daughter, a Skrull refugee she rescues.
stages.whoB: The woman who rescues her and the other Skrull refugees.

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Decades after Carol saved her, G'iah gains a share of Carol's powers through the Harvest.
stages.whoA: Talos's daughter, whom she saved. She gains a share of Carol's powers.
stages.whoB: Her rescuer decades ago, whose powers she shares through the Harvest.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Goose is Wendy Lawson's cat, who takes an unusual liking to Carol. After Lawson's death, Goose travels with Carol and Nick Fury into space.
stages.whoA: Lawson's cat, who takes to her and travels with her into space.
stages.whoB: The woman she takes a liking to and follows into space after Lawson's death.

stages.title: The Marvels
stages.text: Goose now lives with Carol aboard her ship, passed on to her by Maria Rambeau. When the S.A.B.E.R. station is in danger, Goose and her newborn kittens help get the crew out.
stages.whoA: Her cat, who lives aboard her ship. Goose and her kittens save the crew.
stages.whoB: Her owner, whose ship she lives on. She helps save the crew with her kittens.

stages.title: The Marvels
stages.text: Kamala is Carol's biggest fan and dreams of being like her. When their powers become entangled, they team up with Monica Rambeau as the Marvels to stop Dar-Benn, and Carol guides her as a hero.
stages.whoA: Her biggest fan, who becomes her teammate and protege as the Marvels.
stages.whoB: Her hero. Their powers tangle, and Carol guides her as a fellow Marvel.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Korath serves with Carol on Starforce while she is known as Vers. When she turns against the Kree, he is among the soldiers she defeats on Earth.
stages.whoA: A Starforce comrade from her days as Vers, beaten when she turns on the Kree.
stages.whoB: Vers, his Starforce comrade, who turns on the Kree and defeats him on Earth.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Mar-Vell, posing as Dr. Wendy Lawson, mentors Carol Danvers as a test pilot. Carol gains her powers when Mar-Vell's engine explodes.
stages.whoA: Her mentor, posing as Dr. Wendy Lawson. Her exploding engine gives Carol powers.
stages.whoB: Her test pilot and protege, who gains powers when the engine explodes.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Maria Rambeau is Carol Danvers's best friend from their days as Air Force pilots, and she helps raise Monica with her. When Carol returns without her memory, Maria helps her remember.
stages.whoA: Her best friend from the Air Force, who helps her remember who she is.
stages.whoB: Her best friend and fellow pilot, who helped raise Monica. Returns with no memory.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Minn-Erva is Carol Danvers's Starforce teammate and rival. She resents Carol and later tries to kill her.
stages.whoA: Her Starforce teammate and rival, who resents her and tries to kill her.
stages.whoB: Her Starforce teammate and rival, whom she resents and tries to kill.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Carol Danvers is Monica Rambeau's godmother and like an aunt to her.
stages.whoA: Her goddaughter, like a niece to her.
stages.whoB: Her godmother, like an aunt to her.

stages.title: The Marvels
stages.text: As an adult, Monica is hurt that Carol never came back. Fighting side by side as the Marvels brings them close again.
stages.whoA: Her goddaughter, hurt that Carol never came back. They grow close as the Marvels.
stages.whoB: Her godmother, who never came back. Fighting as the Marvels brings them close.

stages.title: The Marvels
stages.text: Carol Danvers meets Muneeba Khan when Kamala's powers bring Carol into their home. Carol later asks Muneeba's help to keep Kamala safe.
stages.whoA: Kamala's mother, whose help she asks to keep Kamala safe.
stages.whoB: The hero who drops into her home and asks her help keeping Kamala safe.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Natasha fills Carol in on the Snap when she arrives at the Avengers Compound. For the next five years, Carol is part of the Avengers team Natasha runs, checking in from across the galaxy.
stages.whoA: The Avenger who fills her in on the Snap. Carol checks in with her team.
stages.whoB: A new Avenger who joins her team, checking in from across the galaxy.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Carol finds Nebula and Tony stranded aboard the Benatar and carries the ship back to Earth. Nebula then serves alongside Carol in the Avengers through the five years after the Snap.
stages.whoA: Stranded on the Benatar until Carol carries it home. Then a fellow Avenger.
stages.whoB: The hero who carries her stranded ship to Earth. Then a fellow Avenger.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Carol Danvers meets Nick Fury in 1995, and they become friends. She leaves him a pager to call her in an emergency.
stages.whoA: Her friend since 1995. She leaves him a pager for emergencies.
stages.whoB: His friend since 1995, who leaves him a pager for emergencies.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Carol and Okoye both serve in Natasha's Avengers after the Snap, checking in by hologram. In the Battle of Earth, Okoye helps hold off the horde as Carol carries the Nano Gauntlet toward the Quantum Tunnel.
stages.whoA: A fellow Avenger after the Snap, holding off the horde in the Battle of Earth.
stages.whoB: A fellow Avenger after the Snap, who carries the Gauntlet in the Battle of Earth.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: In the Battle of Earth, Peter Parker introduces himself and hands Carol the Nano Gauntlet, and she flies it toward the Quantum Tunnel through Thanos's army.
stages.whoA: A young hero who hands her the Nano Gauntlet in the Battle of Earth.
stages.whoB: The hero he hands the Nano Gauntlet to in the Battle of Earth.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Phil Coulson is a rookie S.H.I.E.L.D. agent when Carol Danvers crash lands on Earth in 1995. When the agency moves to capture her and Fury, Coulson quietly lets them get away.
stages.whoA: A rookie S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who quietly lets her and Fury get away.
stages.whoB: The woman who crash lands in 1995. He quietly lets her escape.

stages.title: The Marvels
stages.text: Prince Yan of Aladna is Carol Danvers' husband through a political marriage.
stages.whoA: Her husband through a political marriage, the Prince of Aladna.
stages.whoB: His wife through a political marriage.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Rocket pilots the Benatar with Carol as co-pilot when the Avengers go after Thanos on the Garden. In the years after, both serve in Natasha's Avengers, and Rocket openly complains about Carol during their check-ins.
stages.whoA: Her pilot on the Benatar and a fellow Avenger, who complains about her.
stages.whoB: His co-pilot on the Benatar and a fellow Avenger, whom he openly complains about.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Ronan works with Starforce while Carol serves the Kree as Vers. When he brings his fleet to bomb Earth, Carol destroys his warheads and forces him to retreat.
stages.whoA: A Kree commander whose warheads she destroys, forcing him to retreat.
stages.whoB: Vers, once of Starforce, who destroys his warheads and drives his fleet off.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Carol finds Soren hiding with the other Skrull refugees and assures her she means them no harm, apologizing for her part in the war. She then helps reunite Soren with Talos and get their people to safety.
stages.whoA: A Skrull refugee, Talos's wife, whom she helps reunite with him.
stages.whoB: The Kree soldier who finds her hiding, apologizes, and reunites her with Talos.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Carol Danvers answers Nick Fury's pager and meets Steve Rogers and the surviving Avengers at their compound. She joins Steve's strike on Thanos at his garden planet and fights beside him in the Battle of Earth.
stages.whoA: The Avengers' leader. She joins his strike on Thanos and fights beside him.
stages.whoB: Fury's hero, who joins his strike on Thanos and fights beside him.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: The Supreme Intelligence controls Carol Danvers through her implant until she breaks free of it.
stages.whoA: The Kree ruler controlling her through her implant, until she breaks free.
stages.whoB: Vers, a soldier it controls through her implant until she breaks free.

stages.title: The Marvels
stages.text: Carol has since gone back to Hala and destroyed the Supreme Intelligence, and the Kree blame her for the civil war that follows.
stages.whoA: The Kree ruler she destroyed, setting off Hala's civil war.
stages.whoB: The Kree soldier who broke free, then returned to Hala and destroyed it.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Talos first hunts Carol and digs through her memories for the location of the Light-Speed Engine. He then shows her that the Kree have lied to her and the Skrulls are refugees, and she helps his people escape the Kree to find a new home.
stages.whoA: A Skrull leader who hunts her, then shows her the truth. She saves his people.
stages.whoB: The Kree soldier he hunts, who learns the truth and helps his people escape.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Carol Danvers destroys Thanos's warship and fights him in the Battle of Earth.
stages.whoA: The Titan whose warship she destroys before fighting him in the Battle of Earth.
stages.whoB: A hero who destroys his warship and fights him in the Battle of Earth.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Carol Danvers finds Tony Stark and Nebula drifting in deep space after Thanos' victory and carries their ship back to Earth. She then fights alongside Tony in the Battle of Earth.
stages.whoA: Stranded in deep space until she carries his ship home. An ally in battle.
stages.whoB: The hero who carries his drifting ship to Earth, then fights beside him.

stages.title: The Marvels
stages.text: Carol Danvers and Valkyrie become good friends after the war with Thanos. When a Kree attack leaves the Skrulls without a home, Carol calls Valkyrie for help sheltering them.
stages.whoA: Her good friend since the war with Thanos, who helps shelter the Skrulls.
stages.whoB: Her good friend, who calls on her to help shelter the homeless Skrulls.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Yon-Rogg takes Carol from Earth, gives her his blood and erases her memories, then trains her as the Kree soldier Vers. When she learns the truth, she turns on him, beats him, and sends him back to Hala.
stages.whoA: The Kree commander who stole her memory and trained her. She beats him.
stages.whoB: His stolen recruit, Vers, who learns the truth and beats him.

stages.title: The Marvels
stages.text: Carol Danvers drops into the Khan home when her powers tangle with Kamala's, startling Yusuf on his couch. When the Kree attack the house, she catches a staff about to be driven into Yusuf and throws his attacker through the roof.
stages.whoA: Kamala's father. She saves him from a Kree attacker in his home.
stages.whoB: The hero who drops into his living room and saves him from a Kree attacker.

stages.title: The Punisher S1
stages.text: Carson Wolf is sent to hunt down David Lieberman and tries to kill him.

stages.whoB: The agent sent to hunt him down and kill him.

stages.text: Carson Wolf is a Homeland Security agent who tortures Frank for information about Micro. Frank kills him.
stages.whoA: The man he tortures for information about Micro. Frank kills him.
stages.whoB: A Homeland agent who tortures him for information about Micro. He kills him.

stages.text: Carson Wolf is Sam Stein's boss at Homeland Security, and his dislike for Stein leaves him stuck at a desk in a hallway. After Wolf's murder, Stein writes up his autopsy and uncovers thirty million dollars hidden in his offshore accounts.
stages.whoA: An agent he dislikes and keeps stuck at a hallway desk.
stages.whoB: His boss, who keeps him at a hallway desk. Stein later finds his hidden millions.

stages.text: William Rawlins brings Carson Wolf into his illegal operations and sends him after David Lieberman.
stages.whoA: The man who brings him into illegal operations and sends him after Lieberman.
stages.whoB: His man in Homeland Security, sent after David Lieberman.

stages.text: Casey files the evidence Hunter B-15 brings in, including the Tesseract she seizes from Loki.

stages.text: Victor Timely works alongside Casey and the TVA team to repair the Loom.

stages.whoB: A TVA teammate working beside him to repair the Loom.

stages.text: Kang captures Cassie in the Quantum Realm and threatens her life to force Scott to steal the Multiversal Engine Core for him. Cassie then helps lead the Realm's people in the uprising against Kang.

stages.text: Both go through Terrigenesis in the Kree city, and at the Inhumans' Retreat Raina's visions expose Jiaying's plans to Skye just before Jiaying kills her.
stages.whoA: A fellow Inhuman, whose visions expose Jiaying's plans before her death.
stages.whoB: A fellow Inhuman, whom her visions warn about Jiaying.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Daisy Johnson hunts for the Ghost Rider as a vigilante, and Robbie Reyes first treats her as an enemy. They become friends and allies against his uncle Eli Morrow.
stages.whoA: The Ghost Rider, an enemy at first, then a friend against Eli Morrow.
stages.whoB: A vigilante hunting him, who becomes a friend against Eli.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Robert Gonzales leads the rival S.H.I.E.L.D. that sees Skye's new powers as a threat and sends Bobbi Morse to bring her in. He later comes to the Inhumans' Retreat to make peace, where Skye's mother Jiaying kills him.
stages.whoA: Leader of the rival S.H.I.E.L.D., who sees her powers as a threat.
stages.whoB: A new Inhuman he sees as a threat, whose mother kills him.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Daisy looks out for Robin Hinton, the young seer whose father died helping S.H.I.E.L.D., and gives her a carved robin he made for her.
stages.whoA: A young seer she looks out for after her father's death.
stages.whoB: A protector, who gives her the carved robin her father made.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: When HYDRA captures Phil Coulson, Daisy takes Robin out of hiding to help find him.
stages.whoA: A young seer she brings out of hiding to help find Coulson.
stages.whoB: Her protector, who brings her out of hiding to help find Coulson.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Rosalind Price runs the ATCU, the task force that locks up new Inhumans, and Daisy distrusts her even after Coulson forms an alliance with her. When Rosalind falls during an attack, Daisy catches her with her powers and saves her life.
stages.whoA: The ATCU leader she distrusts, whose life she saves.
stages.whoB: An Inhuman agent who distrusts her but saves her life.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Ruby Hale is raised to see Quake as the rival she must beat to earn her mother's approval. She hunts Daisy down and attacks her with her chakram blade.
stages.whoA: Hale's daughter, raised to beat Quake, who attacks her with a chakram.
stages.whoB: The rival she is raised to beat for her mother's approval.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Sif comes to Earth to stop the Kree warrior Vin-Tak, who wants to kill Skye after her powers emerge, and Sif decides Skye should be taken to Asgard. She relents only after seeing Skye risk herself to protect her friends.
stages.whoA: An Asgardian who wants to take her to Asgard, until she proves herself.
stages.whoB: A new Inhuman she wants taken to Asgard, until Skye proves herself.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Sinara, Kasius' Kree enforcer at the future Lighthouse, helps capture Daisy so she can be sold to the highest bidder. The two fight more than once, and Daisy finally kills her.
stages.whoA: Kasius' Kree enforcer, whom she fights and finally kills.
stages.whoB: A captive she helps sell, who finally kills her.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: The Doctor insists on cutting Daisy Johnson's power inhibitor out of her, whatever the pain.
stages.whoA: Fitz's dark side, who cuts out her power inhibitor, whatever the pain.
stages.whoB: A patient whose power inhibitor he insists on cutting out.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Anton Ivanov, the Superior, leads the Watchdogs in killing Inhumans, and Quake fights him and his men head on. She cripples him in battle, though he keeps coming back through his robot duplicates.
stages.whoA: The Watchdogs' leader, whom she cripples in battle.
stages.whoB: Quake, who fights his Watchdogs and cripples him.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Tucker Shockley is an Inhuman who hates his own kind and works with the Watchdogs. He attacks Quake with his taser rod while stealing the Darkhold, and she takes him down more than once.
stages.whoA: A self-hating Inhuman with the Watchdogs, whom she takes down.
stages.whoB: Quake, who takes him down more than once.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Victoria Hand takes command of the Bus during the search for the kidnapped Phil Coulson and sends Skye off the plane after she hacks without permission. Skye pushes back, insisting that finding Coulson matters more than protocol.
stages.whoA: The commander who takes over the Bus and sends her off.
stages.whoB: A hacker she sends off the Bus for breaking protocol.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Vin-Tak, a Kree warrior, comes to Earth to wipe out the power of the Inhumans and sees Skye as a weapon that must be destroyed. He hunts her through the Playground until Sif and Coulson's team stop him.
stages.whoA: A Kree warrior who hunts her as a weapon to destroy.
stages.whoB: An Inhuman he sees as a weapon that must be destroyed.

stages.title: Eternals
stages.text: Dane Whitman is Sersi's boyfriend and a fellow museum worker in London. He asks her to move in with him just before Arishem takes her away.
stages.whoA: His girlfriend and fellow museum worker, whom he asks to move in.
stages.whoB: Her boyfriend and fellow museum worker, who asks her to move in.

stages.title: Eternals
stages.text: Sprite is Dane Whitman's friend through Sersi, and she teases them both about their romance.
stages.whoA: Sersi's friend, who teases him about their romance.
stages.whoB: Sersi's boyfriend, whom she teases about their romance.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Daniel Blake is Mayor Fisk's aide, who helps Fisk paint Daredevil as a terrorist.
stages.whoA: Daredevil, whom he helps Fisk paint as a terrorist.
stages.whoB: Fisk's aide, who helps paint him as a terrorist.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Daniel Blake talks his way onto Fisk's mayoral campaign through Sheila Rivera, the campaign manager, who takes him on because he will work cheap. They go on to work side by side in Fisk's office, and Rivera has her doubts when Fisk promotes Blake to deputy mayor for communications.
stages.whoA: The campaign manager who takes him on, then doubts his rise.
stages.whoB: A cheap hire she brings onto the campaign, later deputy mayor.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Daniel Blake is a young admirer who joins Fisk's campaign and rises on his staff. Fisk forgives him once for a leak.
stages.whoA: His idol and boss, who forgives him once for a leak.
stages.whoB: A young admirer who rises on his staff, forgiven once for a leak.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Fisk's people murder Blake, and the truth about his death helps turn the city against Fisk.
stages.whoA: His old boss, whose people murder him.
stages.whoB: His former aide, murdered by his people. The truth turns the city.

stages.title: Doctor Strange
stages.text: Daniel Drumm once trains alongside Kaecilius at Kamar-Taj. After Kaecilius betrays the Masters of the Mystic Arts, he storms the New York Sanctum and kills Drumm, its protector.
stages.whoA: A former fellow trainee who storms the Sanctum and kills him.
stages.whoB: A former fellow trainee, the Sanctum's protector, whom he kills.

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Dottie Underwood is a Leviathan assassin who fights Daniel Sousa in an office stairwell and escapes him.
stages.whoA: A Leviathan assassin who fights him in a stairwell and escapes.
stages.whoB: An SSR agent she fights in a stairwell and escapes.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: In Los Angeles, Sousa and Peggy Carter capture Dottie and force her to help them against Whitney Frost, but she gets away again.
stages.whoA: The Leviathan assassin he captures and forces to help, who escapes again.
stages.whoB: An agent who captures her and forces her to help, until she escapes.

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Daniel Sousa first meets Edwin Jarvis as a suspect while the S.S.R. hunts Howard Stark, and Jarvis secretly gives Sousa a tip in a fake American accent.
stages.whoA: Howard's butler, a suspect who secretly tips him off in a fake accent.
stages.whoB: An SSR agent who suspects him, and whom he tips off in disguise.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: In Los Angeles, Sousa and Jarvis become allies, working with Peggy Carter against Whitney Frost.
stages.whoA: Howard's butler, now an ally against Whitney Frost.
stages.whoB: An SSR agent, now an ally against Whitney Frost.

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Daniel Sousa hunts Howard Stark for the SSR, which believes Howard sold his weapons to enemies overseas.
stages.whoA: The inventor he hunts as a suspected traitor.
stages.whoB: An SSR agent hunting him on suspicion of selling weapons.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Howard has since been cleared, and in Los Angeles he helps Daniel's team fight Whitney Frost and her Zero Matter.
stages.whoA: The inventor he once hunted, now cleared and an ally against Frost.
stages.whoB: The agent who once hunted him, now an ally against Whitney Frost.

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Daniel Sousa and Jack Thompson are fellow S.S.R. agents who often clash. Driven mad by the Midnight Oil gas, Sousa tries to kill Thompson, but the two later team up with Peggy Carter to stop Johann Fennhoff.
stages.whoA: A fellow SSR agent he clashes with, and tries to kill when gassed.
stages.whoB: A fellow SSR agent he clashes with, who tries to kill him under the gas.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: In Los Angeles, Sousa and Thompson team up with Peggy Carter again to stop Whitney Frost.
stages.whoA: A fellow SSR agent, teaming up again against Whitney Frost.
stages.whoB: A fellow SSR agent, teaming up again against Whitney Frost.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7
stages.text: When Jemma poses as Peggy Carter at the S.S.R. in 1955, Daniel Sousa sees through the act and arrests her. After the team saves him from the death history had planned for him, he joins them aboard Zephyr One.
stages.whoA: An agent he catches posing as Peggy, then joins on Zephyr One.
stages.whoB: The SSR agent who arrests her in 1955, then joins the team.

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Daniel Sousa unknowingly interrupts Johann Fennhoff, posing as Dr. Ivchenko, while he is hypnotizing Chief Dooley. At Stark's warehouse Sousa corners Fennhoff at gunpoint, and Fennhoff tries to talk his way into Sousa's mind.
stages.whoA: Dr. Ivchenko, the hypnotist he corners at gunpoint.
stages.whoB: An SSR agent who corners him, whose mind he tries to talk his way into.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Daniel Sousa and Peggy Carter fight their way past Joseph Manfredi's guards and pressure the mob boss into helping them against Whitney Frost, his former lover. Manfredi ends up working with them.
stages.whoA: A mob boss, Whitney's ex, whom he pressures into helping.
stages.whoB: An SSR agent who pressures him into helping against Whitney.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7
stages.text: When Daniel Sousa joins the team after they save him in 1955, May shakes his hand and her new empathy picks up how overwhelmed he is. Realizing he means to run, she flies a Quinjet after him, and the team saves him from being killed.
stages.whoA: An agent who senses his panic and flies after him to save him.
stages.whoB: A new recruit whose panic she senses, and whom she chases to save.

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Daniel Sousa and Peggy Carter work together at the SSR, and he quietly falls for her.
stages.whoA: His SSR colleague, whom he quietly falls for.
stages.whoB: Her SSR colleague, who quietly falls for her.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: In Los Angeles, Peggy and Daniel finally admit their feelings for each other and share a kiss.
stages.whoA: The woman he loves. They admit their feelings and share a kiss.
stages.whoB: The man she loves. They admit their feelings and share a kiss.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7
stages.text: By the time Sousa joins Coulson's team, he and Peggy have long since broken up and gone their separate ways.
stages.whoA: His former love, from whom he has long since parted.
stages.whoB: Her former love, long since parted from her.

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Ray Krzeminski mocks Daniel Sousa's war injury and laughs off Sousa's demand that he apologize to Peggy Carter. Still, the two work the night shift together and follow the tip that leads them to Stark's stolen inventions.
stages.whoA: A colleague who mocks his war injury, but works the night shift with him.
stages.whoB: A colleague he mocks for his injury, and his night shift partner.

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Roger Dooley is chief of the S.S.R.'s New York office, where Daniel Sousa works under him chasing leads on Howard Stark. Sousa brings Dooley evidence like Stark's car at the Roxxon refinery, and Dooley puts him on the night shift that turns up Stark's stolen inventions.
stages.whoA: His chief at the SSR's New York office.
stages.whoB: An agent under him, chasing leads on Howard Stark.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Rose Roberts follows Daniel Sousa from New York to run the front desk of his new S.S.R. office in Los Angeles. She is his friend and confidante, teasing him about not telling Peggy Carter that he is dating Violet.
stages.whoA: His friend and confidante, running his office's front desk.
stages.whoB: Her boss and friend, whom she teases about not telling Peggy about Violet.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: After Peggy Carter kidnaps Rufus Hunt, she and Daniel Sousa interrogate him in secret. Hunt refuses to give up any names and mocks Daniel's missing leg.
stages.whoA: A prisoner he interrogates, who mocks his missing leg.
stages.whoB: An agent who interrogates him in secret, whose leg he mocks.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Vernon Masters walks into Daniel Sousa's SSR office with a team of FBI agents and orders him to call off his raid on the Arena Club. When Masters later turns on Whitney Frost, he has to make a deal with Sousa, Peggy and Jack Thompson.
stages.whoA: An official who calls off his raid, then has to make a deal with him.
stages.whoB: The SSR chief he orders off the Arena Club, then has to deal with.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Daniel Sousa, now running the SSR in Los Angeles, investigates Whitney Frost alongside Peggy Carter. Working together to stop her brings Daniel and Peggy closer.
stages.whoA: The woman he investigates with Peggy, which brings them closer.
stages.whoB: The SSR chief in Los Angeles, investigating her with Peggy.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Gideon Malick and Daniel Whitehall both rise to lead HYDRA. When they meet in 1970, Malick tells him about the ancient ritual of stones that sends an unlucky member to the planet where Hive waits.
stages.whoA: A fellow HYDRA leader who tells him of the ritual of stones and Hive's planet.
stages.whoB: A fellow HYDRA leader he meets in 1970 and tells about Hive's ritual.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Grant Ward goes to work for Daniel Whitehall after escaping S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.whoA: His new recruit after escaping S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.whoB: His new boss after he escapes S.H.I.E.L.D.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Daniel Whitehall trains R. Hale as one of his HYDRA students and chooses her for his plan to bring a future leader of HYDRA into the world. Long after his death, Hale raises her daughter Ruby for that purpose.
stages.whoA: His HYDRA student, chosen to bear HYDRA's future leader.
stages.whoB: Her HYDRA teacher, who chose her for his plan for a future leader.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Jemma Simmons goes undercover inside Hydra and works her way up into Daniel Whitehall's own lab, spying on him for S.H.I.E.L.D. When her cover is blown, she escapes his organization with Bobbi Morse's help.
stages.whoA: A S.H.I.E.L.D. spy in his own lab, who escapes with Bobbi's help.
stages.whoB: The HYDRA leader whose lab she infiltrates as a spy.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Daniel Whitehall cut Jiaying open to steal her youth and left her for dead. Her husband Calvin Zabo saved her and swore revenge.
stages.whoA: A woman he cut open to steal her youth.
stages.whoB: The man who cut her open to steal her youth and left her for dead.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Daniel Whitehall captures Agent 33, Kara Palamas, and brainwashes her into serving HYDRA, even though she swears she never will. She remains his agent until his death.
stages.whoA: Agent 33, whom he brainwashes into serving HYDRA.
stages.whoB: The HYDRA leader who brainwashes her into serving him until his death.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Peggy Carter captures Werner Reinhardt in 1945 and sends him to prison.
stages.whoA: The SSR agent who captures him in 1945 and sends him to prison.
stages.whoB: Werner Reinhardt, a HYDRA officer she captures in 1945.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Daniel Whitehall leads HYDRA against Phil Coulson's rebuilt S.H.I.E.L.D. and races him for the Kree city and its Obelisk. When Coulson's team storms Whitehall's base, Coulson shoots him dead.
stages.whoA: The director whose S.H.I.E.L.D. he fights, who shoots him dead.
stages.whoB: The HYDRA leader he races for the Kree city, then shoots dead.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Raina works for Daniel Whitehall's HYDRA out of fear, since even she is terrified of him. He threatens her into delivering Skye, and his help lets her track down the Diviner and the Kree city.
stages.whoA: A terrified servant he threatens into delivering Skye.
stages.whoB: The HYDRA leader she serves out of fear, who threatens her into delivering Skye.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Daniel Whitehall, born Werner Reinhardt, rises as a HYDRA officer under Johann Schmidt during the war. For decades afterward he carries on the Red Skull's work.
stages.whoA: His commander in the war, whose work he carries on for decades.
stages.whoB: A HYDRA officer under him, who carries on his work for decades.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Ruby Hale was born from Daniel Whitehall's Hydra program and was raised to see him as her creator.
stages.whoA: A product of his program, raised to see him as her creator.
stages.whoB: Her creator, the HYDRA leader whose program brought her into the world.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Sunil Bakshi is Daniel Whitehall's fiercely loyal second in command, proud to serve a man he calls a disciple of Red Skull. He carries out Whitehall's campaign to destroy S.H.I.E.L.D. and recover the Obelisk.
stages.whoA: His fiercely loyal second in command.
stages.whoB: His leader, whom he proudly calls a disciple of Red Skull.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Dorothy Walker adopted Danielle's mother, Jessica Jones, which makes her Danielle's adoptive grandmother.
stages.whoA: Her adoptive grandmother, who adopted her mother Jessica.
stages.whoB: Her adoptive granddaughter, Jessica's child.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: James Lucas is Luke Cage's father, which makes him Danielle's grandfather.
stages.whoA: Her grandfather, Luke's father.
stages.whoB: His granddaughter, Luke's daughter.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Jessica is Danielle's mother. She raises her daughter in a quiet home and fights off the armed CIA agents who come for them there.
stages.whoA: Her mom, who fights off the CIA agents who come for them.
stages.whoB: Her daughter, whom she raises in a quiet home and defends from the CIA.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Luke is Danielle's father. He returns to her and Jessica once his CIA work is done.
stages.whoA: Her dad, who comes home once his CIA work is done.
stages.whoB: His daughter, whom he returns to after his CIA work.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Mr. Charles is the CIA handler who keeps Danielle's father overseas. His agents also attack her home.
stages.whoA: The CIA handler keeping her dad overseas. His agents attack her home.
stages.whoB: Luke's daughter, whose home his agents attack.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Danielle is the daughter of Jessica Jones and Luke Cage, which makes Jessica's adoptive sister Trish her aunt.
stages.whoA: Her aunt, her mother's adoptive sister.
stages.whoB: Her niece, daughter of Jessica and Luke.

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Davos grows up with Danny in K'un-Lun as his adoptive brother and best friend, and he comes to New York looking for him.
stages.whoA: His adoptive brother and best friend from K'un-Lun.
stages.whoB: His adoptive brother and best friend, whom he comes to New York to find.

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Bitter that Danny became the Iron Fist, Davos steals the power and turns on him.
stages.whoA: His adoptive brother, bitter enough to steal the Iron Fist.
stages.whoB: His adoptive brother, who became the Iron Fist. He steals it from him.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Elektra kidnaps Danny Rand so the Hand can use the Iron Fist to open their door beneath Midland Circle.
stages.whoA: The Hand's weapon, who kidnaps him to use the Iron Fist.
stages.whoB: The Iron Fist, whom she kidnaps for the Hand.

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Danny Rand fights Madame Gao's champions one after another and defeats them.
stages.whoA: Madame Gao's fighters, whom he beats one after another.
stages.whoB: The Iron Fist, who defeats each of them in turn.

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Harold Meachum was Wendell Rand's partner and arranged the plane crash that killed Danny's parents. He later tries to kill Danny, and Danny comes close to killing him.
stages.whoA: His father's partner, who arranged the crash that killed his parents.
stages.whoB: His partner's son, whom he orphaned and later tries to kill.

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Jeri is Danny Rand's lawyer and friend, and she helps him prove who he is.
stages.whoA: His lawyer and friend, who helps him prove who he is.
stages.whoB: Her client and friend, whom she helps prove who he is.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Danny Rand is a fellow Defender. He and Jessica first clash, then fight the Hand together.
stages.whoA: A fellow Defender he clashes with, then fights beside.
stages.whoB: A fellow Defender she clashes with, then fights the Hand beside.

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Joy Meachum was Danny's childhood best friend.
stages.whoA: His childhood best friend.
stages.whoB: Her childhood best friend.

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Joy turns on Danny and works with Davos against him.
stages.whoA: His childhood best friend, who turns on him and joins Davos.
stages.whoB: Her childhood best friend, whom she turns on with Davos.

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Lei Kung trains Danny in K'un-Lun and raises him as an adoptive father. He prepares Danny to become the Iron Fist.
stages.whoA: His teacher in K'un-Lun and adoptive father, who makes him the Iron Fist.
stages.whoB: The boy he trains and raises as his own, to become the Iron Fist.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Danny Rand and Luke clash when they first meet, then become close friends and fellow Defenders.
stages.whoA: A fellow Defender, a foe at first, then a close friend.
stages.whoB: A fellow Defender, a foe at first, then a close friend.

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Danny comes to Harlem to help Luke in his war with Bushmaster.
stages.whoA: His close friend, whom he helps in the war with Bushmaster.
stages.whoB: His close friend, who comes to Harlem to help against Bushmaster.

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Madame Gao kidnaps and tests Danny Rand, the Iron Fist. He fights her and the Hand.
stages.whoA: A Hand leader who kidnaps and tests him.
stages.whoB: The Iron Fist, whom she kidnaps and tests.

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Mary Walker befriends Danny in her gentle Mary persona while her violent Walker side works for Joy and Davos to capture him. She helps Davos steal the Iron Fist, then later turns on Davos and tries to kill him.
stages.whoA: A gentle friend whose violent side helps Davos steal his power.
stages.whoB: Danny, whom her gentle side befriends while her violent side hunts him.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Danny Rand is the Iron Fist. Matt fights beside him in the Defenders and protects him from the Hand.
stages.whoA: A fellow Defender who protects him from the Hand.
stages.whoB: The Iron Fist, a fellow Defender he protects from the Hand.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Misty becomes friends with Danny Rand while they fight the Hand together.
stages.whoA: A friend made fighting the Hand.
stages.whoB: A friend made fighting the Hand.

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Misty fights beside Danny and Colleen Wing against Davos.
stages.whoA: A friend who fights beside him against Davos.
stages.whoB: A friend she fights beside against Davos.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Murakami joins the other Hand leaders in hunting the Iron Fist, and Danny fights him personally when the Hand ambushes the Defenders at a Chinatown restaurant.
stages.whoA: A Hand leader who hunts him, whom he fights in Chinatown.
stages.whoB: The Iron Fist, whom he hunts and fights at a Chinatown restaurant.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: After Luke captures Sowande, the Defenders interrogate him, and he mocks Danny as the dumbest Iron Fist he has ever met. When he tries to escape, he holds a knife to Danny's throat and reveals that the Hand needs the Iron Fist, before Stick kills him.
stages.whoA: A Hand captive who mocks him and holds a knife to his throat.
stages.whoB: The Iron Fist the Hand needs, whom he mocks and holds at knifepoint.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Stick joins the Defenders against the Hand and helps keep Danny tied up so the Hand cannot take him. When he learns the Hand needs the Iron Fist, he decides to kill Danny himself, but Elektra kills Stick before he can.
stages.whoA: An ally who keeps him from the Hand, then decides to kill him.
stages.whoB: The Iron Fist he guards from the Hand, then decides he must kill.

stages.title: Iron Fist S1

stages.text: Melina works for Dreykov as the Red Room's lead scientist, designing the mind control he uses to enslave his Widows. When her daughters return, she turns on him and helps bring the Red Room down.
stages.whoA: His Red Room scientist, who designs his mind control, then turns on him.
stages.whoB: Her boss, whose Widows she enslaves, until she turns on him.

stages.title: Black Widow
stages.text: Dreykov raises Natasha as an assassin in the Red Room. She defects by trying to kill him in Budapest, and years later she returns to free the Widows and destroy the Red Room.
stages.whoA: His Widow, who tries to kill him and later destroys the Red Room.
stages.whoB: The man who raised her as an assassin, whom she returns to destroy.

stages.title: Black Widow
stages.text: Dreykov is Antonia Dreykov's father. He turns her into Taskmaster and controls her.
stages.whoA: His daughter, whom he turns into Taskmaster.
stages.whoB: Her father, who turns her into Taskmaster and controls her.

stages.title: Black Widow
stages.text: Dreykov controls the Black Widows with a chemical that takes over their minds.
stages.whoA: His slaves, held by mind-controlling chemicals.
stages.whoB: Their master, who controls their minds with a chemical.

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: In 1998, Varra spies on Dreykov for Nick Fury and brings him intelligence on Dreykov's men.
stages.whoA: A Skrull spying on him for Fury.
stages.whoB: Her target, whom she spies on for Fury in 1998.

stages.title: Black Widow
stages.text: Dreykov takes Yelena into the Red Room as a child and keeps her under chemical mind control as one of his Widows. Once she is freed, she turns on him and kills him as the Red Room falls.
stages.whoA: One of his Widows, taken as a child. Freed, she turns on him.
stages.whoB: The man who stole her childhood and controlled her mind.
